messages:
kevin: Heads-up: prospective enterprise wants BYOK import + must meet EU data residency. They also demand documented RBAC change windows and an incident SLA for key compromise. Tagging @ana @sree for compliance/ops input.

ana: Small correction — its @ana not @ana? (typo) but on substance: we need a freeze window for RBAC changes around imports. Recommend change window = business hours + 48h notice for persistent operator grants. For emergency JIT we require approval chain + automated audit.

sree: For JIT we can do timeboxed role assumption (STS token) with session tags: requester, ticket_id, approver_ids. Enforcement: token TTL 1h for imports. Any import action must include ticket_id in context or it fails policy.

kevin: Good. Legal asks: can we promise 3yr immutable audit retention? They flagged contractual language around tamper evidence.

carmen: Tech answer: yes. We can export signed audit bundles daily, store in Object Lock (governance) and mirror to customer-controlled S3 if requested. Signature: ed25519 from our signing service with certificate chain. We'll include firmware hash of HSM and vendor attestation in bundle metadata.

sree: Important vuln triage note: if vendor HSM has a critical CVE, imports should be blocked by policy until mitigated. We should add a pre-import step that verifies HSM model + firmware hash against allowlist. If mismatch -> abort and open P1.

sec-bot: advisory: vendor-hsm-cve-2026-021 flagged for models "Vera-1" and "Vera-2". See internal: https://infra/hsm/advisories/2026-021

kevin: If an operator key is suspected compromised what's minimal IR path we can promise? Legal needs a short bulleted flow.

ana: Sketch: 1) immediate RBAC revoke for operator role (automated), 2) generate and sign forensic export (logs + HSM attestation + current key lineage), 3) if vendor supports quarantine, request vendor action; else mark keys as suspect and schedule rewrap, 4) notify customer with timeline + root cause update, 5) post-incident: rotate KEK and run audit.

sree: Add automation: if we detect multiple ImportKeyMaterial events from different operators within 30 minutes, auto-revoke and create P0. Also throttle repeated failed wrap attempts and escalate.

carmen: Compliance asks for evidence chain: signed manifests with timestamping (RFC3161/time-stamp authority) and storage of manifest in separate signing account. Add that to signed bundle requirements.

kevin: Ops question: can we support escrowless customer-owned HSMs? They want no escrow and no recovery from us.

ana: Yes — escrowless allowed but contract must state no recovery guarantee and responsibilities on customer for backups. Also require HSM attestation and firmware baseline.

sec-bot: action-created: ticket ENGSEC-1984 (BYOK onboarding checklist)

kevin: Action items: Ana -> draft contract clause for escrowless and RBAC change window, Sree -> implement pre-import firmware allowlist check + JIT token flow doc, Carmen -> signed export spec with RFC3161 timestamping. I'll coordinate with Sales/Legal. Thanks all :thumbsup:
